rules.effect: Preserve every retained EBO track polyline and its integer millimetre length; do not create geographic shortcuts or straight-line replacements.
Derive directed edges and route versions deterministically from the retained topology and serialize incompatible use conservatively.
Bind every released route version and every directed leg to the complete pinned timetableRoutes input; missing, ambiguous or discontinuous route coverage leaves the closure ineligible.

Bind every daily physical circulation, rollover permutation and unavoidable cross-location transfer to the v1 transfer-demand sidecar; every transfer must have a real directed OSM route and reproducible plan and transfer-set hashes.

Bind the free GTFS snapshot, its CC BY 4.0 archive proof, the complete selected-segment route set and the v3 derivation report byte-for-byte; reject external operational-network provenance, GTFS shape geometry and invented geometry.
Treat unresolved junction internals as one conservative exclusion scope; do not claim a real turnout role or interlocking position.
Generate internal signal boundaries, overlaps and terminal protection only as conservative authority limits bound to explicit conflict resources.
Materialize an interval only from a deterministic track binding; an unbound visible platform point remains map class C.
Use the restrictive policy profile where no supported observed train-protection value exists; never expose it as installed equipment.
Derive region handovers and the static RZUE layout from the same closed operational graph and stable identifiers.
